caption: The drawing contains three human figures seated side by side within a large blue circular shape near the top center of the composition. Each figure has a brown beard, wears a white robe with blue stripes, and has a green cloak draped over the outside. All three figures wear green head coverings with a cross on top. Their hands are positioned over their chests, and their feet are not visible. Above the figures is a red, scalloped border shaped like a curtain arching over them. Below the blue circular shape, three winged beings, each with human faces, are depicted with red wings; two are smaller and positioned toward the left and right, while the largest is positioned at the center bottom. The central winged being's face is larger than the side figures, and it appears above stylized black-and-white clouds at the very bottom of the drawing. The background is a pale color, and the scene is enclosed within a rectangular gold-bordered frame with a blue sky filling the upper half.
title: Plate 33: The Holy Trinity: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
